newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta share index up 3.3 points.
newsitem.headline: Malta share index up 3.3 points.

text.p: The share index gained 3.3 points in the once-weekly trading session of the Malta Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Market turnover reached 3.2 million Maltese pounds ($8.32 million) from 2.2 million pounds the week before.
Business was spread over 103 deals, of which 26 were in equities and 77 in fixed income securities. The share index rose to 987.96.

Business in equities reached 44,400 pounds, with 37,257 shares transacted. Of these, 8,289 were Bank of Valletta shares transacted in 10 deals for an average price of 123.8 cents, down from 124.5 cents per share the previous week.
There were 10 deals in Mid-Med Bank, with 15,006 shares traded at an average price of 149 cents per share, unchanged.
Lombard bank shares were up, with 5,100 shares changing hands for 143.6 cents from 140.6 cents when last traded two weeks ago.
In soft drinks maker Simonds Farsons Cisk, 8,862 ordinary shares were sold for an average of 50 cents per share, up one cent.
In government stocks, 17 issues were traded, with turnover of 3.1 million pounds. Business was mainly in the 7.25 percent MGS 2006 (III), and the 7.5 percent MGS 2011.
There were 10 deals in Mid-Med Bank 7.25 percent unsecured loan stock 2005 amounting to 9,994.60 pounds and two deals in the 6.5 percent Gasan bonds 1998/00 amounting to 2,961 pounds.
